Biscuits

Filipinos
are
into
crackers
and
biscuits.
As
a
very
workaholic
people, we like having quick, light snacks to fill our stomachs as
we
work
so
as
to
not
starve
and
stay
productive.
The
classics
among
these
items
is
SkyFlakes
Crackers.
SkyFlakes
is
a
plain,
almost bland saltine cracker whose marketing relies almost

entirely on being a temporary snack while working.

The last items are Potato Crackers I got from the Taguig
City Government. They’re not a common brand, but they
still
embody
the
character
of
Filipinos
to
like
bite-sized
bread
like
pandesal
so
as
to
still
be
fed
while
working.
Plus — I chose the cheese flavor, too :3.
